# Native ownership contract review data

These are hand-authored synthetic review traces for [N0-03's authoritative ownership contract](../../../docs/engine/native-contract.md#observeactobserve-races-and-human-override), drafted on 2026-10-16 for [issue 9](https://github.com/whoodes/namtab/issues/9). They supply no executable writer/model, public schema, complete corpus, runtime result or NG0 acceptance. The canonical native contract owns every rule; this directory owns local provenance and integrity only.

- `writer-races.json` covers two human clients and an agent, endpoint-bound takeover, background targeting, remapping/incarnation/sizing, partial mode changes, in-flight/unknown calls, lost ACK, batch/deadline boundaries, Escape ambiguity and residual process effects.
- `protected-handoff.json` covers all ordinary routes under known protection, fresh TUI human secret entry, spoofed/suspected prompts, separate broker review, source/engine loss and undetectable/unmediated prompt limits. No credential value is included.
- `reply-traces.json` covers split/repeated identical queries with two views, partial reply versus writer takeover, protection closure, uncertain crash/replay and bounded reply floods. Hex is explicit synthetic volatile input for review only.
- `rejection-cases.json` proposes forbidden outcomes for N09–N16 and V03/V10/V11. The field/route/gate lists describe independent variations, not simultaneously executed actions or another error vocabulary.

Every actor, identity, source record, handoff, event, target label, clock, hex value and outcome is invented. No process runs and no user recordings, secrets, personal paths, environment values, upstream code or copied conformance corpus is present. Exact byte extents assume authorization to disclose these synthetic extents. The manifest hashes complete public fixture files for local integrity, never real input, low-entropy secrets or live request bodies. No dependency or project license is adopted.

The profile `n0-writer-model/0` and its finite state/ordering/bounds are defined in the contract. Independent branches have their own initial state; `order` only orders that branch and is not a session event number. Branches may use prose source events/operation labels instead of production wire fields; this does not omit required authority checks. Each mutation label stands for a valid issued request key and reserved receipt under `n0-receipt-model/0`; duplicate and historical queries reuse the original identity. Unchallenged grants, context, target, encoding, protection, freshness and clock/deadline preconditions match as stated in each file. Adapter source records are broker input facts within a branch, not extra submitting principals/endpoints in this review profile. Partial/in-flight examples are independent scheduling alternatives; no branch carries a suffix or a lease into another.

`expected` contains proposed hand-authored oracles, not observed output or implementation-generated results. Future independent V03/V10/V11 models must move each context/revoke/protection change immediately before/after first and suffix authorization, call completion and ACK loss, enumerate interleavings, and challenge these expectations. They also need genuine endpoint/PTY, protected review, secret-exposure and resource tests; none is run here. Correct an erroneous oracle by reviewing the canonical rule and recording why before changing its integrity hash. JSON parsing, link checks, range/coverage checks and hash equality establish only static data/document consistency.

[manifest.json](manifest.json) maps local data to requirements/navigation/validation families and SHA-256 values. The shared fixture manifest, native identity/receipt fixtures, source/data/license pins and old X4/EA1 evidence remain unchanged; historical FAIL remains FAIL.
